United Nations Security Council.fact: Per the G4 proposal, the new permanent members would not immediately gain veto power; instead, that matter would be reviewed after a transitionary period of 10 to 15 years. In 2017, the G4 nations indicated willingness temporarily to forgo veto power if granted permanent seats.  The permanent members have announced their positions on Security Council reform reluctantly.  The United States has supported the permanent membership of Japan and lent its support to India and a small number of additional non-permanent members. Zayadina.fact: Jazzar's first priority was subduing the Zayadina and destroying their forts. With his men from Majd al-Krum, Abu Sinan and Deir Hanna, Ali launched an abortive assault on Jazzar's forces at Amqa.
